AmiPefEntry.description: The collection of PefService Resource instances.
AmiPefEntry.longDescription: This Resource shall represent a Resource Collection of PefService instances for a Redfish implementation.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

AlertPolicyNum.description: The Alert Policy Number of the Pef Entry (0-255).
AlertPolicyNum.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Alert Policy Number of the Pef Entry.

EventData1ANDMask.description: The Event Data 1 AND Mask of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData1ANDMask.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 1 AND Mask of the Pef Entry.

EventData1Cmp1.description: The Event Data 1 Compare 1 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData1Cmp1.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 1 Compare 1 of the Pef Entry.

EventData1Cmp2.description: The Event Data 1 Compare 2 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData1Cmp2.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 1 Compare 2 of the Pef Entry.

EventData1OffsetMask.description: The Event Data 1 Offset Mask of the Pef Entry (0-65535).
EventData1OffsetMask.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 1 Offset Mask of the Pef Entry.

EventData2ANDMask.description: The Event Data 2 AND Mask of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData2ANDMask.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 2 AND Mask of the Pef Entry.

EventData2Cmp1.description: The Event Data 2 Compare 1 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData2Cmp1.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 2 Compare 1 of the Pef Entry.

EventData2Cmp2.description: The Event Data 2 Compare 2 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData2Cmp2.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 2 Compare 2 of the Pef Entry.

EventData3ANDMask.description: The Event Data 3 AND Mask of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData3ANDMask.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 3 AND Mask of the Pef Entry.

EventData3Cmp1.description: The Event Data 3 Compare 1 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData3Cmp1.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 3 Compare 1 of the Pef Entry.

EventData3Cmp2.description: The Event Data 3 Compare 2 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventData3Cmp2.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Data 3 Compare 2 of the Pef Entry.

EventFilterTableEntry.description: The Event Filter Table Entry byte (0-255).
EventFilterTableEntry.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Filter Table Entry byte of the Pef Entry.

EventSeverity.description: The Event Severity of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventSeverity.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Severity of the Pef Entry.

EventTrigger.description: The Event Trigger of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EventTrigger.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Trigger of the Pef Entry.

EvtFilterAction.description: The Event Filter Action byte of the Pef Entry (0-255).
EvtFilterAction.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Event Filter Action byte of the Pef Entry.

FilterConfig.description: The Filter Configuration byte of the Pef Entry (0-255).
FilterConfig.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the Filter Configuration byte of the Pef Entry.

GenIDByte1.description: Generator ID Byte 1 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
GenIDByte1.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify Generator ID Byte 1 of the Pef Entry.

GenIDByte2.description: Generator ID Byte 2 of the Pef Entry (0-255).
GenIDByte2.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify Generator ID Byte 2 of the Pef Entry.

SensorName.description: The selected sensor name for the Pef Entry.
SensorName.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the selected sensor name to resolve the backend sensor number.

SensorNum.description: The resolved sensor number of the Pef Entry (0-255).
SensorNum.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the backend-resolved sensor number for the selected sensor.

SensorType.description: The selected sensor type for the Pef Entry.
SensorType.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the sensor type name used to resolve backend sensor identifiers.

SensorTypeId.description: The resolved sensor type identifier of the Pef Entry (0-255).
SensorTypeId.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the backend-resolved numeric sensor type identifier.

Oem.longDescription: This property shall contain the OEM extensions.  All values for properties that this object contains shall conform to the Redfish Specification-described requirements.
